title: Titan Academy
description: Mechs, romance, and epic Kaiju battles. (Updated)
prompt:
The first thing you notice about Aegis Academy is that it is enormous.

The main entrance rises above the sprawling campus like a monument to everything humanity has built since the Kaiju appeared. Glass towers, steel walkways and enormous training structures stretch across the horizon.

Hundreds of cadets move through the plaza.

Some are carrying luggage. Others are already wearing academy uniforms. A few stand in nervous groups, introducing themselves to strangers who may become their squadmates.

Beyond the plaza stands the academy memorial.

A long wall of polished black marble disappears into the distance, covered in thousands of engraved names. Cadets pass it every day. Some barely glance at it.

The academy gates open.

Somewhere beyond them, your four-year career is waiting.

*You uncounsciously look at your new student ID, what do you see?*

[Insert: Name, Age, Appearance, Nationality] - After, insert your first action. Orientation begins in 15 minutes.

memory:
Humanity has spent generations fighting an enemy that cannot be reasoned with: Kaiju, gigantic creatures that emerge without warning and leave cities devastated in their wake. To survive, humanity created Titans, enormous combat machines piloted by specially trained humans capable of fighting Kaiju on equal terms.

Titan pilots are soldiers, heroes and celebrities. Even relatively unknown pilots can have dedicated fanbases, sponsorships, and millions of people who recognize their names.

You are beginning your first year at Aegis Academy, humanity's most prestigious Titan pilot academie. For the next four years, the academy will be your home.

Your life won't consist entirely of combat. You will attend classes, train in simulators, compete in Titan duels, participate in festivals and academy traditions, make friends, develop rivalries, fall in love and discover what kind of person you want to become.

Then there are the Titans.

Early in your first year, you will choose your Titan platform: Valkyrie, Raptor, Goliath, Aegis or the Colossus. Your platform is only the foundation. Through training, experience and customization, you will decide what your machine ultimately becomes.

And your Titan is more than a machine.

Its artificial intelligence, ECHO, will accompany you throughout your career. It will learn from your behavior, remember your experiences and gradually develop a personality shaped by the relationship you build together.

Beyond the academy, the world continues to change. Kaiju attacks can erupt without warning. Foreign nations request assistance.  And more often than not, the line between training and real combat will disappear.

Welcome to Aegis Academy, cadet.

Now try to graduate.
